raw_text: China appears to have detected and is tracking an Indian nuclear ballistic missile submarine in the Bay of Bengal, according to Chinese maritime surveillance reports and satellite imagery analysis. The development, if confirmed, would represent a significant shift in the underwater balance of power in the Indian Ocean. A Chinese Type 093 nuclear attack submarine was simultaneously observed in the eastern Indian Ocean. The Indian Navy has not commented on submarine operations, consistent with standard practice of neither confirming nor denying SSBN deployments.
clean_text: USNI News reports China apparently detected and tracking Indian SSBN in Bay of Bengal. Significant shift in Indian Ocean underwater power balance if confirmed. Chinese Type 093 SSN observed simultaneously. Indian Navy maintains standard practice of no comment on SSBN operations.
